mentions.name: flypath
mentions.description: This is a cross-platform development framework for web, iOS and Android native apps, built on the Server-Driven UI philosophy: the backend streams both code and UI to a frontend that just renders what it's told, enabling over-the-air updates. It follows a batteries-included Rails-like philosophy with an ORM, Postgres-based background and cron jobs, Django-style migrations, JSX emails, and an FFI built around a simple "use native" directive in the React Server Component fashion.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building a framework for web, ios and android native development at https://github.com/vmsp/flypath.

It's based on the Server-Driven UI philosophy where the backend streams both code and UI into a frontend that just knows how to render what it's told.
